founded_year.zh: 1956（其前身「大韩证券交易所」3月3日设立，为韩国证券交易所KSE前身）；现行「韩国交易所」法人于2005年1月27日由KSE、KOSDAQ市场、韩国期货交易所（KOFEX）合并设立，初名「韩国证券期货交易所」，2008年2月4日更名为「韩国交易所」
founded_year.en: 1956 (Mar. 3, the Daehan Stock Exchange, predecessor of the Korea Stock Exchange, established); the present-day Korea Exchange was formed Jan. 27, 2005 by consolidating KSE, the KOSDAQ market and the Korea Futures Exchange (KOFEX), initially named the Korea Stock and Futures Exchange, renamed Korea Exchange on Feb. 4, 2008
founded_year.detail:
"Established in 1956" 是 KRX 官方 CEO Message 页给出的成立年份表述，对应的是其前身大韩
证券交易所/韩国证券交易所（KSE）的设立年份，而不是现行统一法人的设立年份——现行 KRX
法人实体是 2005 年三方合并的产物，2008 年才改用「韩国交易所」这个名称。这条历史链条与
现在的多板块结构（KOSPI/KOSDAQ/KONEX）是同一件事的两面，见文件头注释。

founded_year.quote: Established in 1956, the Korea Exchange (KRX) has contributed to Korea's economic development... / 1956 Mar.3 The Daehan Stock Exchange, the predecessor of the Korea Stock Exchange (KSE), established / 2005 Jan.27 Established the Korea Stock and Futures Exchange through consolidation of KSE, KOSDAQ, KOFEX / 2008 Feb.4 Company name change(Korea Stock and Futures Exchange → Korea Exchange)

history.zh: 1956年大韩证券交易所（KSE前身）设立；1974年韩国证券存管院（KSD）设立；1996年KOSDAQ市场设立；1999年韩国期货交易所（KOFEX）设立；2005年1月27日KSE、KOSDAQ、KOFEX三方合并设立「韩国证券期货交易所」；2008年2月4日更名为「韩国交易所」（KRX）；2013年7月1日设立面向中小与创业企业的KONEX市场；2021年4月16日设立KRX清算部门
history.en: 1956 Daehan Stock Exchange (KSE's predecessor) established; 1974 Korea Securities Depository (KSD) established; 1996 KOSDAQ market established; 1999 Korea Futures Exchange (KOFEX) established; Jan. 27, 2005 KSE, KOSDAQ and KOFEX consolidated into the Korea Stock and Futures Exchange; Feb. 4, 2008 renamed Korea Exchange (KRX); Jul. 1, 2013 KONEX market launched for SMEs and startups; Apr. 16, 2021 KRX Clearing division established

organization_form.zh: 公司制（未上市）——依《资本市场与金融投资业法》(FSCMA)，交易所须为《商法》下的股份有限公司；股东名册全部为证券公司等金融机构与政府关联机构，非自身上市公司
organization_form.en: Demutualized (unlisted) — under the FSCMA, an Exchange must be a stock company under the Commercial Act; its shareholder registry consists entirely of securities firms and other financial/government-linked institutions, not a publicly listed entity
organization_form.detail: 与上交所/深交所的传统会员制不同，KRX 法律形式已是股份有限公司（stock company，见FSCMA第373-2条），但股份未公开上市交易，由证券公司等会员机构持有——介于「会员制」与「公司制上市」之间，取 demutualized_unlisted。股东名册数据截至2019年末，见 self_listed 字段。

self_listed.zh: 否——股东名册（截至2019年末）由KB证券、Meritz证券、NH投资证券等国内证券公司及中小企业振兴公团等机构组成，未见自身股票代码或公开市场交易记录

matching_principle.en: Regular session is continuous auction: when new (or modified) orders are received, trade is executed immediately based on price priority and time priority (not applied to issues with low liquidity)
matching_principle.quote: Regular session : Continuous auction / When new (or modified) orders are received, trade is executed immediately based on the principles of price priority and time priority. (not applied to issues with low liquidity)

circuit_breaker.zh: 指数级三阶段熔断（Circuit Breakers）：第一阶段KOSPI（或KOSDAQ）指数较前日下跌8%以上（且持续1分钟），全市场暂停交易20分钟；第二阶段较前日下跌15%以上且较第一触发点再跌1%以上，熔断后以单一价格集合竞价10分钟恢复连续竞价；第三阶段较前日下跌20%以上且较第二触发点再跌1%以上，当日收市，所有申报（含撤单）不可再提交
circuit_breaker.en: Three-phase index-level circuit breaker: Phase 1 — KOSPI (KOSDAQ) index falls 8% or more from the previous day (lasting one minute), entire market suspended 20 minutes; Phase 2 — falls 15% or more plus an additional 1% fall from the Phase-1 trigger, single-price call auction for 10 minutes after activation then resumes continuous auction; Phase 3 — falls 20% or more plus an additional 1% fall from the Phase-2 trigger, market closes for the day, no quotations (including cancellations) may be submitted

sources.title: Guide to Trading in the Korean Stock Market（KRX官网英文版官方手册PDF）

circuit_breaker.quote: KOSPI (KOSDAQ) index falls by 8% or more compared to the previous day. (The fall lasts for one minute.) / The entire market is suspended for 20 minutes. ... The market is closed when the third phase is activated.

volatility_interruption.zh: 个股级波动性中断（Volatility Interruption, VI），分动态VI与静态VI：连续竞价阶段VI触发后转为2分钟单一价格集合竞价；触发价 = 基准价 ± (基准价 × 触发比率)，KOSPI200成份股/ETF等常规交易时段动态VI比率±3%、静态VI比率±10%，其余品种动态VI比率±6%
volatility_interruption.en: Individual-issue Volatility Interruption (VI), split into Dynamic VI and Static VI: when triggered during continuous auction, trading switches to a 2-minute single-price call auction; activation price = reference price ± (reference price × activation rate); for KOSPI 200 constituents/ETFs etc. the dynamic VI rate is ±3% and static VI rate ±10% during the regular session, while other issues use a ±6% dynamic rate
volatility_interruption.detail: 此外还有「sidecar」机制（KOSPI200期货价格5分钟内单方向变动达5%，或KOSDAQ150期货价格变动6%以上且KOSDAQ150指数同向变动3%以上时，暂停程序化交易挂单5分钟），是与VI并行的另一套稳定机制，未单独设字段，写在此处备注，不计入zh/en正文（其涉及的具体比例本次未逐一配 quote）。

sources.title: Guide to Trading in the Korean Stock Market（KRX官网英文版官方手册PDF）

volatility_interruption.quote: When VI is activated during continuous auction session, continuous auction is switched to single price call auction for two minutes. ... Activation price : reference price ± (reference price x activation price rate) ... KOSPI 200 constituents ... ±3% ... ±10% ... Other issues ... ±6%

trading_halt_mechanism.zh: 个股停牌情形包括：上市公司披露重大信息后停牌30分钟；被指定为不实披露法人当日停牌；因传闻/报道引发交易量激增，须待澄清公告后方可复牌；公司未按要求答复问询（KOSPI从逾期到披露、KOSDAQ从逾期到披露后再加30分钟）；交易所认为有必要保护投资者时停牌1天；此外还有因退市事由、股票证书变更、结算会员未按期交收等其他停牌情形
trading_halt_mechanism.en: Individual-issue halts include: 30-minute suspension after a listed company discloses material information; one-day suspension upon designation as an unfaithful-disclosure corporation; suspension pending a clarifying announcement when a volume surge is likely due to rumors/news; suspension when a company fails to respond to a disclosure inquiry (KOSPI: from missed deadline to disclosure; KOSDAQ: from missed deadline to 30 minutes after disclosure); one-day suspension when the Exchange deems it necessary for investor protection; plus other grounds such as delisting causes, stock-certificate changes, and clearing-member settlement failures

sources.title: Guide to Trading in the Korean Stock Market（KRX官网英文版官方手册PDF）

trading_halt_mechanism.quote: Disclosing material information of a listed company — for 30 minutes from the disclosure / Designation of unfaithful disclosure corporation (5 point penalty) — the designation day (one day)

intraday_reversal.detail: 本次抓取材料确认结算周期为T+2（见 clearing.settlement_cycle），但未找到明确说明现货股票「先买后卖是否可当日回转」的条文——结算周期与回转交易规则是两个不同维度，不能相互推断，按铁律留空不猜。

sources.title: Guide to Trading in the Korean Stock Market（KRX官网英文版官方手册PDF）

short_selling.zh: 原则上禁止一切卖空，仅允许「担保卖空」（先借入证券再卖出）；担保卖空须遵守报升规则：卖空申报价格不得等于或低于最近成交价；投资者的净持仓卖空余额达到一定比例/金额须向交易所报告，达到另一（更高）比例须对外披露
short_selling.en: All types of short-selling are prohibited in principle; only covered short-selling (selling securities that have been borrowed) is permitted as an exception, subject to an uptick rule: short-selling orders may not be quoted at or under the most recently matched price; investors must report their net short-selling balance to the Exchange once it crosses certain ratio/value thresholds, and disclose publicly once it crosses a further (higher) threshold
short_selling.detail: 枚举 restricted_uptick 是现有受控词表里与「禁止裸卖空+担保卖空另受报升规则约束」最接近的选项，但比典型的报升规则市场更严格（裸卖空整体禁止），这一细微差别写在此处不强行拆成新枚举值，见 OPEN-QUESTIONS 关于受控词表覆盖度的既有条目。

short_selling.quote: All types of short-selling are prohibited in principle; however, selling securities with borrowing(covered short-selling) is permitted exceptionally. ... Uptick rule : Short-selling orders may not be quoted at or under the most recently matched price.

block_trade.zh: 大宗/篮子交易：KOSPI大宗交易最低数量为5,000倍交易单位（ETF/ETN为500倍）或1亿韩元以上；KOSDAQ为5000万韩元以上；篮子交易KOSPI须5只以上标的且合计10亿韩元以上，KOSDAQ须5只以上标的且合计2亿韩元以上；常规时段大宗交易价格须在申报当日已形成的最高价与最低价之间，盘前盘后大宗交易须在当日涨跌停范围内
block_trade.en: Block/basket trade minimums: KOSPI block trade requires at least 5,000× the trading unit (500× for ETFs/ETNs) or KRW 100 million or more; KOSDAQ requires KRW 50 million or more; basket trades require 5 or more issues and at least KRW 1 billion (KOSPI) or KRW 200 million (KOSDAQ) in aggregate; regular-session block trade prices must fall within the day's highest-to-lowest price range formed so far, while off-hours block trades must stay within the daily price limit

review_system.zh: 由KRX交易所自身按量化门槛（经营年限、股本、股权分散度、财务表现、审计意见等多维标准，达标即可申请，非政府逐案审批）进行上市资格审查；与之并行，证券发行本身另受FSCMA下的证券注册制度约束（发行人向FSC提交证券申报书）——上市审核（交易所）与发行注册（FSC）是两套并行制度，不完全对应受控词表 review_system 现有的注册制/核准制二分，故未套用enum
review_system.en: Listing eligibility is examined by the Exchange itself against quantitative thresholds (years in operation, equity capital, share distribution, financial performance, audit opinion, etc. — meeting the criteria enables application rather than case-by-case government approval); in parallel, the securities issuance itself is separately governed by FSCMA's registration regime (issuers file a securities registration statement with the FSC) — listing review (by the Exchange) and issuance registration (by the FSC) are two parallel systems that do not map cleanly onto the existing registration/approval enum, so no enum value is applied
review_system.detail: 这是 OPEN-QUESTIONS 框架性问题第3条（review_system枚举覆盖度）积累的第五个真实案例：上交所「注册制」、港交所「披露为本+上市委实质审核」、NYSE「披露为本+高度量化具体规则+广泛自由裁量权」、JPX「披露为本，交易所审核+重大事项另报金融厅」、现在KRX「交易所量化门槛审查+FSC独立证券注册」——五家没有一家能被现有枚举干净覆盖。

transfer_between_boards.zh: KONEX市场公司可通过5条「快速通道」（Fast-track）转入KOSDAQ市场，各通道标准不同，例如：通道1需在KONEX上市满1年、经保荐推荐、最近年度营业利润为正、销售额100亿韩元以上、基准市值300亿韩元以上；通道4需销售增长率20%以上、销售额200亿韩元以上、营业利润10亿韩元以上；通道5需少数股东持股10%以上、日均市值200亿韩元以上且超过股本、总基准市值3000亿韩元以上；另有并购后快速上市通道
transfer_between_boards.en: Companies on the KONEX market can move to KOSDAQ via 5 fast-track routes with differing criteria, e.g. Track 1 requires at least one year on KONEX, a designated advisor's recommendation, positive operating income in the latest year, at least KRW 10 billion in sales and at least KRW 30 billion in base market capitalization; Track 4 requires a 20%+ sales growth rate, at least KRW 20 billion in sales and at least KRW 1 billion in operating income; Track 5 requires at least 10% minority shareholders, average daily market cap of at least KRW 200 billion exceeding capital stock, and at least KRW 300 billion in total base market capitalization; a separate fast-track route also exists following a merger

delisting_conditions.zh: KOSPI市场设「管理股指定」与「退市」两级：管理股指定情形含未按期提交定期报告、审计意见为「保留/否定/无法表示意见」、资本侵蚀率50%以上、少数股东少于200人或持股比例低于5%、半年平均月成交量低于流通股1%、外部董事人数不足、不实披露累计扣分达10分以上、营收低于300亿韩元（2026年前为50亿、2026年为100亿、2027年为200亿韩元的过渡门槛，2027年起若最近年度平均市值达1000亿韩元以上可豁免）、市值连续30个交易日低于500亿韩元（2025年前为50亿、2026上半年为200亿、2026下半年为300亿韩元的过渡门槛）等；上述情形连续两年未解决或触发即时退市条款（如连续记录修正审计意见、逾期10日未交业务报告）则直接退市
delisting_conditions.en: The KOSPI market uses a two-tier system — designation as an administrative issue, then delisting. Administrative-issue triggers include failure to submit periodic reports on time, a qualified/adverse/disclaimer audit opinion, a capital impairment ratio of 50% or more, fewer than 200 general shareholders or under 5% shareholding ratio, average monthly trading volume below 1% of free float for a half-year, an insufficient number of outside directors, 10+ accumulated penalty points for disclosure violations, sales below KRW 30 billion (phased-in thresholds of KRW 5bn until 2026, KRW 10bn in 2027, KRW 20bn in 2028), or market capitalization below KRW 50 billion for 30 consecutive trading days (phased-in thresholds of KRW 5bn until 2025, KRW 20bn in H1 2026, KRW 30bn in H2 2026); persistence of these conditions for two consecutive years, or immediate-delisting triggers (e.g. consecutive modified audit opinions, failure to submit a business report within 10 days of the deadline), lead directly to delisting

membership_structure.zh: 持有FSCMA第12(1)条投资交易/投资经纪业务牌照的机构方可申请会员资格；会员按市场范围与产品种类分七类（证券会员/股票证券会员/集合投资证券会员/债务证券会员/衍生品会员/股票衍生品会员/货币利率衍生品会员），并按是否自行承担结算责任分为结算会员与交易会员；财务门槛举例：证券会员+衍生品会员需股本至少400亿韩元且净资本比率100%以上，证券会员+股票衍生品会员需股本至少300亿韩元
membership_structure.en: Entities holding a license for investment trading or investment brokerage business under FSCMA Article 12(1) are eligible to apply for membership; members are classified into seven types by market scope and product coverage (Securities, Equity Securities, Collective Investment Securities, Debt Securities, Derivatives, Equity Derivatives, and Currency-interest Rate Derivatives members), and further split into Settlement Members and Trading Members depending on whether they bear settlement responsibility directly; example financial thresholds: Securities + Derivatives member requires equity capital of at least KRW 40 billion and a net capital ratio of 100%+, while Securities + Equity Derivatives member requires at least KRW 30 billion

regulatory_change_risk_note.zh: KOSPI退市/管理股财务门槛正处于多年分阶段调整期：营收门槛从「2026年底前50亿韩元」逐步提高到「2027年10亿韩元」「2028年200亿韩元」（最终门槛为300亿韩元，2027年起若市值达标可豁免）；市值门槛从「2025年底前50亿韩元」提高到「2026上半年200亿韩元」「2026下半年300亿韩元」（最终门槛为500亿韩元）——这意味着同一份退市规则在不同年份对应的实际数值门槛不同，横向比较或历史数据核对时要注意抓取时点
regulatory_change_risk_note.en: KOSPI's delisting/administrative-issue financial thresholds are in a multi-year phase-in: the sales threshold rises from KRW 5bn (through 2026) to KRW 10bn (2027) to KRW 20bn (2028), with a final KRW 30bn threshold (waivable from 2027 if market cap qualifies); the market-cap threshold rises from KRW 5bn (through 2025) to KRW 20bn (H1 2026) to KRW 30bn (H2 2026), with a final KRW 50bn threshold — meaning the same delisting rule maps to different numeric thresholds depending on the year, which matters for cross-exchange comparison or historical fact-checking depending on when the data was fetched

However, until 2028, the following thresholds apply based on the submission date of an audit report with an unqualified opinion
